subject: PQI
body: Phishing is
options: a scam message to steal your details
a method of fishing with a computer
a fast way to share large files
explanation: Check the sender and never click suspicious links.

subject: PQI
body: Two-factor authentication adds
options: a bigger screen to work on
a second check, such as a code
explanation: Even a stolen password isn't enough to get in.

subject: PQI
body: A web address starting with https:// means
options: the page is free to use
explanation: It doesn't prove the site is honest, only that traffic is encrypted.

subject: PQI
body: Your digital footprint is
options: the trail of data you leave online
a footprint scanned by a phone
explanation: Posts, photos and searches can stay online for years.

subject: PQI
body: Before posting pupils' photos online, a school should
options: get consent and follow privacy rules
share them in any WhatsApp group
explanation: Photos of children are personal data.

subject: PQI
body: Which law governs how schools collect and use personal data in Nigeria?
explanation: The Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 builds on the earlier NDPR.

subject: PQI
body: Pupils' records should be
options: shared on the school's social media
emailed to all parents each term
explanation: Only people who need them should see them.

subject: PQI
body: A learning management system (LMS) is used to
options: deliver lessons and track learning online
design new school buildings and fences
explanation: The strategy plans LMS use in 30,000 secondary schools.

subject: PQI
body: Blended learning means
options: teaching in two languages at once
explanation: It combines the strengths of both.

subject: PQI
body: In a flipped classroom, learners
options: study at home, then practise in class
never do any homework at all
teach the lesson instead of you
sit facing the back of the room
explanation: Class time is used for practice and discussion.

subject: PQI
body: Offline-first teaching tools are useful because
explanation: Important where connectivity is poor.

subject: PQI
body: Which is the safest way to use images in a lesson?

subject: PQI
body: A good use of assessment data is

explanation: Use it to decide what to reteach.

subject: PQI
body: Which is an example of assistive technology?
options: a new staff room with fans
a faster Wi-Fi router for staff
a screen reader for a blind learner

explanation: Assistive tech helps learners with disabilities take part.

subject: PQI
body: Universal Design for Learning (UDL) aims to
options: serve only the most gifted pupils

subject: PQI
body: AI chatbots can

explanation: Always verify AI output before using it.

subject: PQI
body: Responsible use of AI in class means
options: pasting pupils' records into any app
explanation: Keep a human in charge and protect pupils' data.
